summary: R2-F1: browser QA passes a contract-non-conformant checkout - no commerce-structure/template-contract assertion
details: Fresh browser-QA run MPXR3V5Q1TAC2LU2OLKNNS18MG (2026-06-03) on test-campaign checkout returns ready_with_exceptions, 33 pass / 1 manual_review / 0 fail. Yet the rendered checkout has an empty order-summary region (right column shows only 'Show Order Summary' with no content), no express-checkout wallets, and a broken two-column limos shell vs the correct travel-care limos checkout built through the same skill flow. browser-runtime assertions check individual pieces (mounts, price visible, SDK boot, routing) but none asserts commerce-surface structure / families[family].agentContract conformance / surface ordering, so a structurally broken checkout passes. Repair NOT attempted: fix belongs in campaigns-os QA (new browser-commerce-structure assertion) and needs a Vuk/Devin decision on how strictly each family contract defines surface placement. Build-side cause is out of scope (SELL-362/build lane). QA-only: no campaign code patched.
